How does chlorofluoro carbon deplet ozone layer?

American NASA scientist, in 1858, discovered the depletion of ozone layer over Antartica. found that ozone layer is depleting at an alarming rate. The main cause of ozone layer depletion is chlorofluoro carbons (CFC). These are called Freon's because they are chlorine and fluorine substituted methane. These compounds are non-toxic and stable, so used in refrigerators, air conditioners etc. The common CFC's are CFC13 (Freon II), CC12F2 (Freon 12), CHCIF2 (Freon 22) etc. It is estimated that one molecule of CFC's can destroy 100,000 molecules of ozone.
